lines.text: Hi there, what's up? You're that digger called Mega Man, aren't you?
Hey, what are you looking at me like that for?
Boy, you're younger than they said you were.
Now get me straight. I ain't got nothing against you personally,
but my partner wants to get his hands on the Mother Lode, see?
I haven't done this for a while. Hope I'm not too rusty.
